items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Oh, Billy Hicks and the Sizzling Six... I was in Europe when that happened. But prior to that, it was back in the Thirties, the early Thirties, about '31 or '32, Billy Hicks, Joe Vidas(?), Quinton Harrington and...

ctx.x: One thing I just remembered that you forgot was your experience with Billy Hicks.
